item.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: In-depth exploration of a significant technological development with implications for humanity.

Amazon's Luton warehouse showcases a blend of human and robotic labor, with robots handling tasks like packing and sorting. Humanoid robots, though advancing, struggle to replicate the dexterity of human hands. Investors predict humanoid robots will become commonplace, raising concerns about job displacement. Tesla's CEO Elon Musk emphasizes the challenge of creating a robot with human-like hands. Amazon employs over 1.5 million workers, many of whom could be affected if robots become more capable.

Source: The Guardian Life and Style | Published: 2026-11-21 06:00 UTC

item.title: Your Intuition Is Smarter Than You Think
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: Engaging and informative article on intuition, with practical insights and useful vocabulary.

Intuition, a sense of inner pull, stems from the nervous system, emotions, and unconscious processes. It operates in the brain, with the amygdala detecting threats and the prefrontal cortex interpreting information. Intuition differs from instinct, which is automatic. The brain uses past patterns to guide us, and the gut-brain axis influences intuition.
